exposure: BMI-matched mothers of appropriate for gestational age infants
cohort: 46 nondiabetic mothers, 22 who gave birth to LGA infants and 24 BMI-matched controls who gave birth to appropriate for gestational age infants.
finding: Only 29 genes were differentially expressed in placentas from mothers of LGA infants, with top upregulated genes involved in growth and metabolism and top downregulated genes involved in growth suppression and structural components.
birth_weight: LGA and appropriate for gestational age
